summary: The agent successfully implements a robust feature engineering pipeline and trains a diverse set of tree-based models. However, it completely fails to compute any validation metrics, defining validation folds but never evaluating on them. Additionally, the final ensemble relies on arbitrary manual weights instead of an optimized blending strategy, and there is data leakage across the internal cross-validation splits due to scaling and imputing prior to splitting.
